No written measuring-point definition or technical drawing is published; the Stedman resources page illustrates 'Garment Sizes' with a photo of a tape measured flat across the front just below the armholes, so Width is stored as halfChestCm (flat chest width). Length is stored as bodyLengthCm; Stedman does not state the start point (HPS assumed industry convention, not confirmed by Stedman).
ST2000.notes: Size label mapping shop -> manufacturer: XXL -> "2XL". Sleeve length not published by Stedman (null). Product page, product-sheet PDF and 2026 garment sizes PDF agree.

No tolerance stated on the sheet.
